[RTIM.14.15] **Test atoms the interpreter cannot read refuse the run.** A
runtime's load skips the `Test*` / `Oracle*` family ([RDSC.9.4]), so the
interpreter reads it itself, whole, before any case runs. It **must** refuse
the run, running no case, when a test atom's body does not decode
([RDSC.9.5]), with `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE`, or when a test atom names something no
atom in the artefact defines ([RDSC.8.7]), with `DS_ERR_DSC_DANGLING`. In each
case it names the atom, and it checks the bodies before the names, as a load
does.

A conforming compiler writes neither ([RLOW.17.1], [RDSC.9.9]), so either is
a damaged or forged artefact, and no case's verdict over it means anything.
